title: Public Alert No. 03/2026–Alert on the Circulation of an Unauthorized and Unregistered Risperdal 2 mg Tablets Brand Formulation in Nigeria
summary: NAFDAC warns that an unauthorized, unregistered batch of Risperdal 2 mg tablets is circulating in Nigeria, notably Kaduna State. Johnson & Johnson confirmed batch ELB01723 was meant for Turkey but illegally diverted; its pack artwork differs from the registered brand.
